prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the WorldMap component is a regular <svg> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for svg elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/svg) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)

Called when the user clicks on a place. It is passed the location.

'location' is an array of two numeric values that indicates the latitude and longitude of the specified location. It should be given a 'name' for accessibility. 'onClick' and 'onHover' allow user interaction with each place. 'content' and 'dropProps' allow attaching additional content near each place.
